subject: SWATShiny App GUI disappears After Windows 10 goes into sleep mode

messages.author: a57a5baeca7e037e
messages.subject: SWATShiny App GUI disappears After Windows 10 goes into sleep mode
parts:
Dear Tam,
I am grateful to you and the other developers for creating this app. I recently observed that SWATShiny app GUI (both version 2.2 and the latest version) disappears when Windows 10 goes into 'sleep mode '. Even though, the Shiny App disappears, the model continues to run. This is seen when I constantly check the  'CurrentSimulationReport.txt' in the Output folder found in the workingFolder.
My questions are :
1. How do I bring up the GUI interface without stopping the process in the R Console?
2. Does R-SWAT save my previous run automatically after I have run an iteration for a number of simulations?

Thank you 

Best regards 
Peter Odoom

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: SWATShiny App GUI disappears After Windows 10 goes into sleep mode
parts:
1. Sorry I haven't face this problem before (GUI turn of when window is in sleep mode)
2. Yes, it save all of the simulations (that has been finished) in the workingFolder, but currently there is no option to continue the last run once it was break in the middle

Thank you for your swift response.
 I allowed the simulations to finish. I confirmed this from the 'CurrentSimulationReport.txt' in the Output folder. I stopped the process in the console and relaunch the app. The simulations were saved as you stated in your answer and I was able to evaluate the run.
Thank you once again

regards
Peter
